Widget family: LIST / TABLE

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A grid-like arrangement of rows and cells is visible.
2. The header row differs from body rows (stronger/darker fill, different weight, or distinct background).
3. When striping is claimed: body rows alternate fills (or equivalent zebra striping).
4. When column separators are claimed: vertical lines or clear column divisions separate cells.
5. FAIL if: header matches body rows, no multi-column structure when claimed, missing striping when claimed, or no rows.
